source_caption_text:
Never forget when Chief Keef turned his bathroom into both a gaming room and a recording studio 😭😂

Via; @colourfulmula 👈

Keef once shared a photo of a wall-mounted TV, an Xbox and a controller positioned directly across from the toilet while Destiny was running on the screen. His explanation was only two words: “Why not” 💀

Years later, the idea went even further. In March 2023, designer Colourfulmula shared footage of Sosa creating music in a bathroom equipped with a laptop, speaker and beat machine. Keef could be seen testing chords and working on a beat beside the shower and toilet.

Chief Keef has always been heavily involved in gaming and music production, but combining everything inside the bathroom was next-level efficiency. From playing Destiny to making beats without ever leaving the room… Sosa was living in 2050 😭💯
